description_en: Performs a paging query on the device ownership identifiers of the current tenant. You can filter the results by identifier type, record ID, or the intersection of both. The IDs returned by the batch add operation can be used to query newly added records. The returned record IDs can be used for batch removal
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户的设备归属标识，支持按标识类型、记录 ID 或两者的交集筛选。可用批量添加接口返回的 ID 查询新增记录。返回的记录 ID 可用于批量移除
name: ListDeviceBelongIdentifiers

parameters.help_en: The list of record IDs to query. You can specify 1 to 100 positive integer decimal strings at a time. If this parameter is specified along with other filter parameters, the records that meet all the conditions are returned
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的记录 ID 列表。每次可传 1 至 100 个正整数十进制字符串。与其他筛选参数同时传入时，返回同时满足条件的记录
parameters.name: identifier_ids

parameters.help_en: The identifier type. MAC indicates the MAC address of the network interface controller (NIC), SystemSN indicates the system serial number, and BIOSSN indicates the BIOS serial number. This parameter is required when IdentifierValues is specified
parameters.help_zh: 标识类型。MAC 表示网卡 MAC 地址，SystemSN 表示系统序列号，BIOSSN 表示 BIOS 序列号。传入 IdentifierValues 时必须指定此参数
parameters.name: identifier_type

parameters.help_en: The list of identifier values for exact match. You can specify 1 to 100 items at a time, and each item can contain 1 to 128 characters. You must specify IdentifierType at the same time. Records that match any value in the array are returned. MAC addresses are uniformly converted to the lowercase colon-separated format. System serial numbers and BIOS serial numbers are case-sensitive and space-sensitive
parameters.help_zh: 待精确匹配的标识值列表。每次可传 1 至 100 项，每项 1 至 128 个字符。必须同时指定 IdentifierType，匹配数组中任一值即可。MAC 统一转为小写冒号格式，系统 SN 和 BIOS SN 区分大小写和空白
parameters.name: identifier_values

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，取值范围为 1 至 2147483647
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大记录数，取值范围为 1 至 1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A reserved pagination parameter. This value is not used in the current version. Use PageSize to specify the number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 预留分页参数，当前版本不使用该值。请通过 PageSize 指定每页条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved pagination cursor. This value is not used in the current version. Use CurrentPage to specify the page number
parameters.help_zh: 预留分页游标，当前版本不使用该值。请通过 CurrentPage 指定页码
parameters.name: next_token

Identifiers.description_en: The device ownership identifier records on the current page. An empty list is returned if no matching records are found
Identifiers.description_zh: 当前页的设备归属标识记录。没有匹配记录时返回空列表

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the record was created. The time is in RFC 3339 format and includes time zone information
CreateTime.description_zh: 记录创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式，包含时区信息

IdentifierId.description_en: The ID of the identifier record, returned as a decimal string. You can use the ID to query or remove the record
IdentifierId.description_zh: 标识记录的 ID，以十进制字符串返回。可用于再次查询或移除该记录

IdentifierType.description_en: The identifier type. MAC indicates the MAC address of the network interface controller (NIC), SystemSN indicates the system serial number, and BIOSSN indicates the BIOS serial number
IdentifierType.description_zh: 标识类型。MAC 表示网卡 MAC 地址，SystemSN 表示系统序列号，BIOSSN 表示 BIOS 序列号

IdentifierValue.description_en: The identifier value in the record. MAC addresses are in the lowercase colon-separated format. System serial numbers and BIOS serial numbers are returned as recorded
IdentifierValue.description_zh: 记录中的标识值。MAC 采用小写冒号分隔格式，系统 SN 和 BIOS SN 返回记录值

MaxResults.description_en: A reserved pagination field. No valid value is returned in the current version
MaxResults.description_zh: 预留分页字段，当前版本不返回有效值
MaxResults.title_en: 暂未启用，请以 PageSize 为准。
MaxResults.title_zh: 暂未启用，请以 PageSize 为准。

NextToken.description_en: A reserved pagination cursor. No valid value is returned in the current version
NextToken.description_zh: 预留分页游标，当前版本不返回有效值
NextToken.title_en: 暂未启用，不返回有效游标。
NextToken.title_zh: 暂未启用，不返回有效游标。

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于定位该次调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the filter conditions for the current tenant
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前租户在本次筛选条件下匹配的记录总数
